units.text: The assertion that Apple's fiscal 2025 effective tax rate was 21% is false. Multiple sources report the effective rate as 15.6% or 17.0%, while 21% refers only to the US federal statutory tax rate.

citations.title: Apple : Annual Report for Fiscal Year Ending September 27, 2025 (Form 10-K) | MarketScreener
Apple's Tax Strategy: A Case Study in Effective Tax Rate Management | Venkatraman Kamath posted on the topic | LinkedIn
Apple SEC filings: What Apple’s 2025 10-K Reveals

judgement.reason: The passages support a 15.6% effective tax rate and contrast it with a 21% US federal tax rate, but none mention a 17.0% rate, and the 21% figure is not described as 'statutory' or as the 'only' reference in the cited passages.

units.text: Source 8e504e8f explicitly states Apple's FY2025 effective tax rate was 15.6%, with the 21% figure identified as the US federal tax rate.
